title: His even white teeth glistening here and there with gold points.
html_source:
Metallurgists had shown favor to gold being used to fill in cavities in the crown surface of molar teeth; as opposed to steel being used.
Dentists took notice of this and even in this time period of the 20th century, they implemented them.

PROPOSED SUGGESTION: This is the first occurrence of the episode’s nominated colours, white and gold. (Although Mulligan wears a yellow dressing gown.)
